# Acomulated volumes

The acomulated volumes files describes the relationship between the free surface heigth and the reservoir water's volume. The keywords are:

- <Fill>....</Fill> - a block containig free surface heigths/reservoir water's volume. It must be ordered, increasing from the top to the bottom of the file.
